name: AURA
description: AURA stands for Automated Utility for Retrieval of Assets. It is a tool designed to use Mediux images for your media server content. It provides a simple and intuitive web interface to browse and select image sets for your library. While there are many tools available for this purpose, AURA stands out by offering a visual web interface to preview images before selection. Works with Plex, Emby, Jellyfin and Silo, and can apply images to several media servers at once. Everything is set up in the web interface on first start.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Config Directory. Holds the AURA database (your settings and saved sets) and the logs. Must be on a local disk or pool, not a network share.

paths.name: Media Path
paths.description: Path to the media directory. Both the host and container paths must match the Plex/Emby/Jellyfin/Silo path exactly. Read the configuration guide for more information.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: This is port for the WEB UI/Frontend of the app

variables.name: Disable Authentication
variables.description: Set to true only if you are locked out of AURA, for example after a forgotten password or a broken OIDC setup. Log in, fix the Authentication settings, then set this back to false. While it is true, anyone who can reach AURA can use it.

variables.name: Import config.yaml
variables.description: Set to true to import a config.yaml placed in the Config Directory on the next start, replacing the current settings. Set it back to false afterwards.

variables.name: Database Path
variables.description: Optional. Path of the database file. A relative path is inside the Config Directory. Leave empty to use AURA.db in the Config Directory.
